description: This file defines a report for process loss in manufacturing, including functions to fetch data, generate columns, and perform calculations related to work orders and stock entries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to get report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches data using query arguments and updates process loss value.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for the report.

methods.name: get_query_args
methods.description: Prepares query arguments including filters and conditions.

methods.name: run_query
methods.description: Executes SQL query to retrieve manufacturing process loss data.

methods.name: update_data_with_total_pl_value
methods.description: Calculates total process loss value per row based on FG value and actual produced quantity.

methods.name: get_filter_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL filter conditions based on provided filters.
